summary: The retired DAEDALUS predecessor automation 6ab8177918b48191a97e56c44b57d2c5 remains enabled and is still executing hourly even though the current Hybrid Loop Fabric registry contains no matching lane/automation identity and classifies DAEDALUS PRIME under replacement identity 6abb103472608191b72f9eaa522b772b as HISTORICAL_DISABLED/MANUAL_GITHUB_REQUEST_ONLY. The replacement identity is absent from the live automation list. This creates orphan execution, duplicate-assurance, request-identity and control-plane drift risk.
surface: ChatGPT scheduler identity, Hybrid Loop Fabric registry, DAEDALUS durable request routing

current_registry.finding: No lane references the running predecessor automation_id. DAEDALUS PRIME is registered as daedalus_prime under replacement identity 6abb103472608191b72f9eaa522b772b with current_state HISTORICAL_DISABLED and MANUAL_GITHUB_REQUEST_ONLY.

current_contract.finding: A valid unresolved request must match the exact lane and automation_id before substantive work or completion.

migration_record.finding: Explicitly maps this predecessor to replacement 6abb103472608191b72f9eaa522b772b and states predecessor IDs were unmodifiable.

historical_verification.finding: Previously claimed exactly five replacement tasks enabled and bound DAEDALUS to the replacement identity.

request_state.observation: Both direct main-branch fetches returned 404, so this predecessor has no valid exact-lane request identity.

evidence.uncertainty: The audit did not mutate the scheduler. It is unknown whether the replacement automation was deleted, moved to another inaccessible account/workspace, or never survived the later topology cutover.

required_remediation: At the account control plane, pause the orphan predecessor 6ab8177918b48191a97e56c44b57d2c5 or explicitly re-register it under a compatible exact identity; do not leave it enabled but unrequestable.
Reconcile the replacement identity 6abb103472608191b72f9eaa522b772b against the live automation inventory and either restore it intentionally or update the registry with a verified current owner.

Add a control-plane invariant that every enabled hybrid worker appears exactly once in registry with matching lane, automation_id, state, cadence and request namespace; reject orphan or duplicate identities.
Do not accept research/hybrid completion from an enabled worker whose exact registry/request identity is absent.
next_independent_verification_target: After scheduler reconciliation, inspect the live automation inventory and registry together, then issue one immutable manual DAEDALUS request and verify exact request→receipt/event→hybrid-result read-back under a single identity.

daedalus.finding: Live scheduler topology contradicts both the current registry and the documented predecessor-to-replacement migration; the running worker has no valid durable request identity.

aegis.finding: An orphan worker can generate duplicate or misattributed assurance artifacts outside exact lane/request identity, so all substantive completion from this execution must fail closed.
